Source of the driver (tag v1.2025.0.119), next to the binaries:
  vmdisp9x-1.2025.0.119.tar.gz (https://github.com/JHRobotics/vmdisp9x/archive/refs/tags/v1.2025.0.119.tar.gz)

Universal Service OS installs the VESA part on Windows 95/98/Me disks it
prepares (docs/win9x-modern-2026-09-30.md) with its own INF,
src/platform/bios/win9x/usosvesa.inf, a MODIFIED copy of vmdisp9x.inf that
keeps only the VESA model (PCI display class, *PNP0900). The stick carries
these files in EFI\USOS\dos-native\win9x\ with this text as VMDISP9X.TXT.
